messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up: HealthFlow wants written confirmation that for their POC all inference requests, logs, and routing metadata will remain in eu-central-1. They also asked for a committed quote for 3x H100 reserved for 6 months to present to procurement.
Diego (Solutions Engineer): Quick clarifying Q: do they require the control plane (or just data-at-rest/in-transit) to be EU-only?
Maya (AE): Quote from customer: "No control-plane hops or telemetry to non-EU endpoints; key material must stay in EU." They raised KMS residency as well.
Ola (Infra): Short answer: our hosted/shared control plane is global and may call non-EU infra for some control-plane work/telemetry. To meet strict no-exit guarantees -> Dedicated with Private control plane or Private installation in eu-central-1. Dedicated + VPC peering + customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key via EU KMS/HSM) covers this.
Priya (Privacy): For contracts we can offer an EU-only sub-processor carve-out and a DPA addendum. Legal needs to sign off but we have precedent for similar asks. I'll prepare the one-page attestation and subproc export.
Diego (Solutions Engineer): Operational caveats to call out in the board note: - Cross-region fallback disabled (no automatic failover to non-EU) - Monitoring endpoints must be EU-only (we can scope to EU monitoring providers) - No model snapshot replication outside EU unless customer opts in
Maya (AE): Pricing request: what's a procurement-ready ballpark for committed 3x H100 in eu-central-1 for 6 months? They want to put the number into purchase request.
Ola (Infra): Back-of-envelope: committed reserved 3x H100 in eu-central-1 ~ 45k-55k/month depending on SLA + EU-only monitoring add-on. I'll get final numbers from pricing ops.
Diego (Solutions Engineer): I'll draft a one-paragraph statement HealthFlow can present to their security board. Here it is, paste-ready:

"Redwood will provision a Dedicated inference deployment in eu-central-1 with a private control plane and VPC peering to ensure all inference requests, control-plane operations, and telemetry remain within EU boundaries. Customer-managed KMS/HSM can be used to keep key material in-region. We will exclude non-EU sub-processors for this deployment and provide a contractual attestation (DPA addendum and sub-processor manifest). Any required exceptions will be documented and escalated to legal for approval."

Maya (AE): Perfect. Can someone paste canonical links for the EU-only subproc export and DPA template I can attach?
Priya (Privacy): Internal subproc list: https://redwood.example/subprocessors/latest ; EU-only export: https://redwood.example/subprocessors/eu-only-download. DPA template (redacted): https://redwood.example/legal/dpa-eu-template.pdf. I'll follow up with the attestation PDF.
DeployBot: Ticket #8819 created: private-controlplane-eu-central request queued. Estimated 72 hours to produce deployment template.
Ola (Infra): Note for Diego/Maya: Dedicated/private options require we disable automatic cross-region routing in the service profile; also no async analytics export will be enabled. There is an operational lead time for EU-only monitoring stack.
Maya (AE): Action items: Diego  draft runbook + board paragraph (done), Ola  confirm firm pricing & infra limitations, Priya  prepare attestation + subproc export + DPA excerpt. I'll send to HealthFlow and request their security questionnaire.
Diego (Solutions Engineer): I'll schedule a 30-min technical POC kickoff for 09:00 CET tomorrow and include options for VPN vs VPC peering.
Priya (Privacy): I'll post the attestation doc here once legal signs off.
Maya (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
